summary: Allot Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) on November 12, 2026, attaching a press release announcing unaudited third-quarter 2026 financial results. Reported figures include revenue of $30.6 million, up 16% year-over-year, SECaaS revenue of $9.9 million, SECaaS ARR of $38.8 million, and operating cash flow of $7.4 million. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine earnings filing, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
